subject: Pricing follow-up: token volumes & benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@acme-retail.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & pricing follow-up (token volumes + benchmark)

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have the same baseline and a couple of asks to move the pricing discussion forward: 

Summary of usage notes you shared:
- Primary use: chat summarization + search re-rank for product pages
- Expected steady-state: ~50M tokens / month (prompt + output)
- Burst / growth window: up to 200M tokens / month during peak campaigns
- P0 latency requirement: sub-300ms for interactive paths (95th percentile)

Key pricing questions we agreed to confirm:
1) Target budget range for inference (monthly): you mentioned a ballpark of $6k–$15k / month, could you confirm?
2) Target unit economics: do you have an internal target $/1M tokens we should aim for when proposing committed pricing? You indicated wanting something meaningfully below your current host costs.
3) Commitment horizon: are you open to a 6–12 month committed plan in exchange for lower $/1M pricing?

What I shared on the call (benchmarks):
- OpenAI (public rates) equivalency: ~ $20–$25 per 1M tokens for the family you referenced
- Anthropic public rates: ~ $22–$28 per 1M tokens depending on model variant
- Typical open-model hosting (self-hosted or third-party hosts) ranges widely: $10–$30+ per 1M tokens depending on infra efficiency and discounts

For Redwood, depending on commitment level and model choice (quantization & batching profiles), we typically target a delivered price in the $10–$18 / 1M tokens range for customers at your scale with a committed contract. I attached our high-level pricing sheet to illustrate committed vs on-demand tiers.

Next steps I propose:
- Liam / Priya: confirm target budget range and ideal $/1M token target (reply inline)
- I'll send a quick unit-economics breakdown (per 1M token) and a sample committed pricing proposal for a 6- and 12-month term
- If the numbers look good, we schedule a short procurement / legal intro to review SOW / MSA and finalize commitment

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf (summary committed vs on-demand tiers)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the per-1M breakdown within the hour.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf (pdf, 78KB)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@acme-retail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@acme-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & pricing follow-up (token volumes + benchmark)

Thanks Vanessa — helpful recap. A few clarifications / asks from our side: 

- Budget: the $6k–$15k was a rough internal band. After talking to finance this morning, the team is comfortable with $10k–$18k / month if unit economics work out (we can push to the higher end with a firm commitment).
- Target $/1M tokens: ideally we want to get to ~$12 / 1M tokens or lower for steady-state. If that’s unrealistic, please show us the delta vs our current host.
- Commitment: yes, willing to consider a 6–12 month commitment if pricing is attractive and we get an SLA for latency during peak windows.

Also attaching our internal forecast (Q3/Q4) so you can see seasonality assumptions and better size committed tiers: acme_token_estimates.xlsx

Could you include an example per-1M token cost breakdown (infra / infra + ops / amortized caching gains) so finance can validate the math?

We’ll aim to get procurement looped once we see a sample committed quote.

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Connor
Product Lead, Search & Recommendations | Acme Retail
liam@acme-retail.com | +1 (312) 555-0123
[Attachment: acme_token_estimates.xlsx (xlsx, 44KB)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@acme-retail.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & pricing follow-up (token volumes + benchmark)

Great — thanks for the clarity, Liam. Attached is a short per-1M token cost breakdown that isolates the major drivers (infrastructure, networking, model licensing if applicable, ops/monitoring, and caching/batching savings we typically realize for product-search workloads). I pulled a conservative Redwood example for steady-state 50M tokens/mo and a committed 12-month profile.

High-level example (all values illustrative):
- Baseline infra + model runtime: $14 / 1M tokens
- Networking & storage amortized: $1.5 / 1M tokens
- Ops / monitoring / SLA overhead: $1 / 1M tokens
- Caching & batching realized savings (workload-dependent): -$4 to -$6 / 1M tokens
= Delivered price (illustrative) = $12.5 / 1M tokens for committed 12-month profile

For on-demand / no-commit, delivered price would be ~ $16–$18 / 1M tokens in the same model family.

We can model a few committed tiers and a ramp (e.g., 50M steady -> 100M -> 200M) and show blended $/1M across months if that helps finance. I’ve added two suggested committed pricing rows in the attached PDF: per_1M_token_cost_breakdown.pdf.

Next proposed steps:
- If $12 / 1M is within range, we prepare a formal committed quote for 6- and 12-months (I’ll include SLA bullet points for latency & uptime).
- Marissa (cc’d) will be the pricing owner internally and can loop in legal for standard MSA redlines if we proceed.
- Would you prefer a single blended committed tier or a ramped committed schedule?

I’ll also add a short mutual action plan doc in HubSpot after you confirm which committed horizon you prefer.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: per_1M_token_cost_breakdown.pdf (pdf, 62KB)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@acme-retail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@acme-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & pricing follow-up (token volumes + benchmark)

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Vanessa. $12.5 / 1M (illustrative) is in the ballpark.

Next from our side:
- We’ll review the attached breakdown and forecast; Priya will confirm preferred commitment (leaning toward 12-month ramp).
- I’ll introduce our procurement contact (Maya Patel) on the next thread so you can share the formal quote / SLA language.

Can we set a 30-minute sync next Tue to walk procurement through the numbers? 10:00–10:30 PT works for us.

Thanks — Liam
[Attachment: none]
